faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Wallet Card Case suitable for Ultra-slim titanium wallet card holder?
faq.a: Titanium Wallet Card Case uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address edc operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Wallet Card Case?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Wallet Card Case is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for ultraslim titanium wallet requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Wallet Card Case require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. ultraslim titanium wallet components require PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for ultraslim titanium wallet application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Wallet Card Case shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Wallet Card Case includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet ultraslim titanium wallet specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
